description: This source file defines a custom annotation @AllValuesAreNonnullByDefault used to specify that all fields, method return values, and parameters within a package, class, or method are to be treated as non-null by default. It is part of the Eclipse Ditto utilities for JSR-305 annotations, facilitating null-safety annotations in Java code.

classes.name: AllValuesAreNonnullByDefault
classes.description: Custom annotation indicating that all applicable elements (fields, method return values, parameters) are non-null by default within the annotated scope.
